services.name: Lions Campground
services.desc: Leader Lions Campground is a seasonal campground located in the Town of Leader next to Leader Swimming Pool and backing on to the Leader Lions park. The campground operates on a first come/first serve basis. If you are planning a stay that exceeds 5 nights, contact the Town Office to inquire about a long-stay reservation. Self registration and other information you will need is posted at the entrance to the campground. Street Address:151 1st Street West, Leader, SKMailing Address:P.O. Box 39, Leader, SK S0N
